## Scope settings + progress checkpoints (update 31)

### Agent runtime
- Progressive stage checkpoints (10-round stages, continuation on host limit)
- Host execution limit converts to durable checkpoint + continuation notice
- Parallel independent tool calls within one orchestration round
- Orchestration limit error copy cleanup

### Workspace
- Scope settings modal + automation feed
- Session scope-settings route and project scope via PUT /projects/:id
- Continuation notices in ChatPane (applicationNotice)

### Scheduler
- SQLite to JSON store migration + migrate tool
